properties.description: Road-corridor landslide susceptibility, Sikkim pilot. This is a zone-level susceptibility assessment derived from a spatially validated model. It does NOT predict the exact time of a landslide. Road-corridor scope: the training inventory has strong road-survey bias (96.1% of positives within 100m of a mapped road), so predictions are only produced for road corridors, not arbitrary terrain. No real-time rainfall is included -- this is the static layer; rainfall is a separate dynamic alert layer.
